subject: Gartner reference call request — BrightPath AI / latency & cost impact

Subject: Gartner: request for customer reference call (BrightPath AI)

Hi Marissa,

I'm working on a short research note about inference economics and multitenant vs dedicated serving patterns, and I'd like to speak with a customer who has migrated to Redwood Dedicated and can speak specifically to latency and cost delta after the migration. BrightPath AI was suggested as a good candidate.

Would Redwood be able to coordinate a 30–45 minute reference call next week? Ideal topics: before/after latency numbers, token-unit cost trends, deployment architecture (dedicated vs hosted), and any rollout caveats.

Possible windows: Tue 3 Feb 14:00–16:00 ET, Wed 4 Feb 10:00–12:00 ET. Happy to be flexible.

Thanks,
Priya Menon
Research Director, Infrastructure & Platforms
Gartner

This is not a public citation request; call will be used as a background interview for a research note.

Hi Elena — hope you are well. Priya Menon from Gartner is researching inference economics and asked if BrightPath would be willing to do a short, background reference call about your migration to Redwood Dedicated. Priya's focus areas are latency, cost per token (before/after), and deployment tradeoffs.

We estimate 30–45 minutes. Proposed windows (ET): Tue 3 Feb 14:00–15:00, Wed 4 Feb 10:30–11:15. Priya is flexible; please let me know what works for you.

To help with prep I've attached a short Reference QA and a summary brief that summarizes the metrics we'd expect to discuss. If you're open, we'll share a one-pager prior to the call and keep the conversation background-only (no public quote without prior approval).

If you'd prefer a written Q&A instead of a live call, that's also fine — we can submit the questions.

Many thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, GTM — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa / Priya — happy to help. Thanks for sending the materials; the brief looks accurate. We can do Tue 3 Feb 14:30–15:15 ET. We'll plan to have myself and one of our SRE leads on the call (short intro then Q&A).

A couple of quick notes for the agenda:
- What changed in how we route inference requests after Dedicated vs hosted (high level)
- 95th percentile latency improvements (we saw ~30% improvement for long-tail requests after tuning batching)
- Cost per 1M tokens: rough delta pre/post (we can share ballpark numbers but prefer ranges rather than exact contract rates)
- Any customer-facing gotchas (cold-start, KV cache priming)

Background-only is fine. If Gartner would like a short written summary after the call, we can provide that for accuracy before any public mention.

Best,
Elena Soto
VP Engineering, BrightPath AI
